description: This is a React component implementing a guided skill validation chat interface. It facilitates user interaction to validate skills through a step-by-step conversational flow, managing state, rendering messages, and handling user input without backend dependencies.

methods.name: safeTrim
methods.description: Trims the input value safely, converting unknown to string and removing whitespace.

methods.name: toTopUnique
methods.description: Filters an array of strings to return a list of unique, trimmed, case-insensitive entries limited to a specified size.

methods.name: derivePersonaContext
methods.description: Constructs a PersonaContext object from a JSON object, extracting and deduplicating skills and strengths.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a given prefix and timestamp.
